sources.title: TIGER/Line Shapefiles 2024 — County and Equivalent
sources.national_archive_license: U.S. federal Census geographic data; public-domain use.
sources.selection: OGR extraction of counties in STATEFP 04, 06, 16, 32, 41, 53 (Arizona, California, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Washington). 209 polygons from the official national TIGER/Line 2024 source, retaining the assigned counties and all plausible contiguous domestic county neighbors.
sources.assigned_county_roster: 97 complete CA/WA source counties: 58 California plus 39 Washington; every 2018 geoBoundaries source county has a 2024 state/name/GEOID counterpart.
sources.attributes: GEOID/STATEFP/COUNTYFP, NAMELSAD, CLASSFP, ALAND and AWATER retained in the selected GeoJSON.
sources.restoration: Download canonical national archive, verify 83,913,260 bytes and SHA-256 above, run `ogr2ogr -f GeoJSON <output> /vsizip/<archive>/tl_2024_us_county.shp tl_2024_us_county -where "STATEFP IN ('04','06','16','32','41','53')"`, then compare the uncompressed selected subset hash in this registry. Do not treat ALAND/AWATER as a sovereignty determination.

baseline.source: Published WorldAtlas current main, issue #487 v5 scope; exact IDs and geography release pins are in scope.json and issue-metadata.json.

retention_and_methods: No inaccessible source claims are filled by inference. Full USA 2018 geoBoundaries sources and all CA/WA 2024 Census Places archives are lawfully retained. The national Census TIGER/Line county ZIP is recorded by exact bytes/hash; its reproducible six-state selected features are retained to avoid duplicating the 84 MB national download. The cross-border contact screen additionally retains the exact Abbotsford ADM3 feature from pinned geoBoundaries Canada; its full-layer hash/size and selected-feature hash are recorded. Its topology warning limits use to a candidate contact screen.
